title: SQL Learning Portfolio
text:
Project Overview
This learning portfolio documents SQL techniques for selecting, filtering, grouping, and summarizing data.


Skills Demonstrated

Conditional transformations with CASE
Row-level filtering with WHERE
Group-level filtering with HAVING
Aggregate and conditional-aggregate functions
Analytical queries for customer and marketing data



Business Application
These SQL techniques can support campaign measurement, customer segmentation, survey analysis, conversion-rate calculations, and performance reporting.

title: Case 31 Customer Insights Dashboard
text:
Project Overview
This project analyzes survey data from Employees Federal Credit Union. The dataset contains 128 respondents and measures employee service, overall ratings, loan usage, and customer perceptions.


Key Measures

Overall credit union rating
Employee courtesy
Employee helpfulness
Employee professionalism
Employee availability
Current loan usage



Key Findings
Most valid responses rated the credit union as Excellent or Good. Employee courtesy and helpfulness received particularly strong ratings. The analysis also identified opportunities to improve employee availability and promote relevant loan products.

title: Styling Quarto with CSS and SCSS
text: A portfolio website should communicate information clearly while also presenting a consistent professional identity. CSS controls the visual appearance of HTML pages, while SCSS extends CSS with features such as variables and organized style sections.

title: Styling Quarto with CSS and SCSS
text:
Example Styled Card
This card demonstrates how a custom SCSS class can be used inside a Quarto document. Reusable classes make it possible to apply the same format to multiple sections without repeating styling instructions.
